verdict.comment: Storm Free and Special Acclaim are respected but the return to faster ground can see DAN TUCKER make a winning reappearance.

comments.ciderbob: Useful pedigree but didn't offer enough in two runs last summer to make him of interest
comments.dantucker: Ran a fine race at Redcar on his 2nd outing; less good on soft twice after; gelded; solid
comments.luckielucas: Dam a 5f winner from a good sprinting family; fair standard to aim at on debut; hooded
comments.nachonachonacho: 50,000gns half-brother to 5f-6f winner Solar Aclaim; yard's newcomers often better for run
comments.purpendicular: Seven of her eight siblings have won races; had wind op prior to her debut; best watched
comments.sharpcall: Improving run by run on AW; further progress required to trouble principals on turf debut
comments.specialacclaim: Travelled nicely but failed to pick up on recent AW debut (6f); can do much better in time
comments.stormfree: Useful form in defeat on AW last autumn; leading form claims back from 165 days off
comments.woburn: 100-1 and little short-term encouragement at Wolverhampton three weeks ago (7f)
comments.yorkshiremyth: Two soft-ground runs last autumn, showing better form over 7f; bred to need more of a test

races.raceComment: dantucker is marginally preferred with a score of 26.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and more progressive over stormfree. Placed in 1 of last 1 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 3 attempts. Yet to win at nottingham in 4 attempts. Key attributes include superior ratings, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.bornarebel: Recorded sole win off 3lb higher last April; possibilities if back to that form

verdict.comment: Three-time course winner MEWS HOUSE took a sizeable step back in the right direction last time and is taken to snap a losing sequence.

comments.dunningtonlad: C&D winner; two wins at Ripon last summer; in the mix if fully tuned up on return
comments.goldenprosperity: Poor strike-rate but won over C&D last August and could build on last month's reappearance
comments.jamieschoice: Lightly raced 5yo who won twice last summer and could have more to offer
comments.latinfive: Won at Newcastle in February; only fifth there the next twice but still in with a chance
comments.mewshouse: On long losing run but took step back in right direction last time and he likes it here
comments.ninetynine: Absent since below-par run on AW in December but in good form previously (C&D winner)
comments.poshmaisie: Has dropped to a basement mark but not shaping as though she's about to get off the mark
comments.stroxx: Finds winning hard but was on the scoresheet in January and was short-headed last week
comments.ustath: 9yo who has poor turf strike-rate but has been in fair form on AW and could be thereabouts

races.raceComment: ninetynine is marginally preferred with a score of 45.3%, holding clear edges in superior course form over latinfive. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
